name: Feedspace: Best Testimonials & Reviews Widget for WordPress Sites
author: Feedspace

sections.description:
Feedspace is a powerful WordPress testimonial plugin that helps you collect, manage, and showcase customer testimonials, reviews, and social proof beautifully right on your website. Built for marketers, agencies, and businesses, Feedspace turns feedback into conversions.

Useful Links
Support | Product updates | Video Tutorials | Facebook Group | Upgrade | Demo

🔥 Why Feedspace?
Feedspace helps you collect authentic feedback from customers and display it in interactive layouts that fit seamlessly into your website design.

✔ Clean, lightweight, and SEO-friendly
✔ Simple setup that requires no technical skills
✔ Mobile-friendly & responsive layouts
✔ Optimised for user experience and performance
✔ Easy setup, just use your Widget ID and embed
✔ Customize layouts, colors, and styles without coding
✔ Show reviewer names, roles, photos, and star ratings
✔ Works with Elementor, Gutenberg, and all major page builders
✔ Suitable for any type of website, including SaaS, agencies, and eCommerce

Wanna Import Reviews from Different Platform?
Visit: Import Reviews

Key Features

✔ Different Display Options
✔ Easy Customization
✔ Import & Sync Easily
✔ Best SEO & Performance
✔ Smooth Integration

Check out all features by Feedspace
Check out Now!

How It Works

  1. Get Your Widget Data ID: In your Feedspace account, open the widget → Share → Add form to Website → next to “Install Now,” click the widget ID (the data-id, e.g., 93670fb7-547e-4ff2-a346-bc228b70be51), then use it in the plugin.
  2. Add to WordPress: Enter the widget data ID in the plugin settings or use the Gutenberg block
  3. Display: Your testimonials appear instantly on your website

External Service Integration

This plugin integrates with Feedspace, our testimonial management platform that provides widget functionality.

Service Links:
– Privacy Policy: https://feedspace.io/privacy-policy/
– Terms of Service: https://feedspace.io/terms-and-condition/

Privacy & Data Handling

Data Collection:
This plugin does not collect, store, or transmit any personal information from your website visitors or WordPress users.

User Tracking:
This plugin does not track users or implement any tracking mechanisms. No cookies are set, and no analytics data is collected.

Data Transmission:
The only data transmitted is widget ID requests to Feedspace’s API to fetch testimonial content. This is done server-side and does not involve user data.

Consent:
No user consent is required as this plugin does not collect or process personal data.

Note: Widget content is served by Feedspace.

sections.installation:
1. Install using the WordPress built-in Plugin installer, or Extract the zip file and drop the contents in the wp-content/plugins/ directory of your WordPress installation.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Get Your Widget Data ID: In your Feedspace account, open the widget → Share → Add form to Website → next to “Install Now,” click the widget ID (the data-id, e.g., 93670fb7-547e-4ff2-a346-bc228b70be51), then use it in the plugin.
  4. Add to WordPress: Enter the widget data ID in the plugin settings or use the Gutenberg block
  5. Display: Your testimonials appear instantly on your website

For documentation visit our Help Center.
sections.faq:
How do I get my widget ID?

Log into your Feedspace dashboard, navigate to the widget you want to embed, and copy the data-id from embed code.

What data is transmitted?

Widget data requests: The plugin sends widget ID requests to Feedspace’s API to fetch testimonial content. No personal user data is collected or transmitted by this plugin. No tracking or analytics data is sent to external services

When does data transmission occur?

Data transmission occurs only when a Feedspace widget is displayed on your website and the plugin requests widget content from Feedspace’s API using your widget ID

Do I need a Feedspace account?

Yes, you’ll need a Feedspace account to get widget IDs. Visit feedspace.io to sign up.

How do I add a widget to my page?

You can use the Gutenberg block editor to add a “Feedspace Widget” block, or use the shortcode [feedspace_widgets] in any post or page.

Does this plugin collect user data?

No, this plugin does not collect any personal information from your website visitors or WordPress users. It only fetches widget content from Feedspace’s API using your widget ID.

Does this plugin track users?

No, this plugin does not implement any tracking mechanisms, cookies, or analytics. It simply displays testimonial widgets from your Feedspace account.

What data is sent to Feedspace?

Only widget ID requests are sent to Feedspace’s API to fetch testimonial content. No personal data, user information, or tracking data is transmitted.
